custom_abilities.name: Agile Movement
custom_abilities.definition: A base Dance Style available to any Dancer. Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks while it is active.
custom_abilities.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

custom_abilities.name: Elegant Form
custom_abilities.definition: A base Dance Style available to any Dancer. Lets you add your Dance Die to a failed Dexterity or Charisma check or save.
custom_abilities.description: When you fail a Dexterity or Charisma check or a saving throw with any ability, you can add your Dance Die to the roll, potentially turning the failure into a success.

custom_abilities.name: Retaliatory Swipe
custom_abilities.definition: A base Dance Style available to any Dancer. Deals Dance Die damage back to adjacent attackers.
custom_abilities.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, the attacker takes damage equal to two rolls of your Dance Die. This damage is the same type dealt by a weapon you're holding or your Unarmed Strike.

custom_abilities.name: Spinning Shot
custom_abilities.definition: A base Dance Style available to any Dancer. Adds your Dance Die to ranged weapon attack rolls.
custom_abilities.description: You can add your Dance Die to ranged attack rolls you make with weapons.

custom_abilities.name: Enthralling Movement [Dance Style]
custom_abilities.definition: Courtesan subclass Dance Style. Charms a nearby creature each turn on a failed Wisdom save.
custom_abilities.description: When you choose this Dance Style and at the start of each of your turns while this Dance Style is active, choose a creature that can see you within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the start of your next turn.

custom_abilities.name: Dueling Stance [Dance Style]
custom_abilities.definition: Fencer subclass Dance Style. Adds your Dance Die to damage when fighting one-handed with no other weapon.
custom_abilities.description: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you can add one roll of your Dance Die to damage rolls with that weapon.

custom_abilities.name: Parry
custom_abilities.definition: New Dancer weapon mastery property. Grants +2 AC until the start of your next turn on a hit, once per turn, when not wielding a Shield.
custom_abilities.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon and you aren't wielding a Shield, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class until the start of your next turn. You can gain this bonus only once per turn.

custom_abilities.name: Shift
custom_abilities.definition: New Dancer weapon mastery property. Grants a free 10-foot move without provoking Opportunity Attacks on a hit.
custom_abilities.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can immediately move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

class_resources.name: Dances
class_resources.definition: A pool of uses that lets a Dancer enter their Dance flow state as a Bonus Action. Regains one use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest.

class_resources.name: Dance Die
class_resources.definition: A scaling die used by many Dancer features (Graceful Dodge, Dance Styles, subclass features). Grows from a d4 to a d10 as the Dancer levels up; it is not a spendable pool.

class_resources.name: Momentum
class_resources.definition: Acrobat-only tracker gained by leaving an enemy's reach or moving 15 feet on your turn while dancing, and expended for bonus damage on a hit. Cap starts at 1 and rises to 3 at 14th level (Deadly Momentum), and unexpended Momentum is normally lost at the end of your turn.

classes.name: Dancer
classes.description:
Becoming a Dancer

As a Level 1 Character

  • Gain all of the traits in the Core Dancer Traits table.
  • Gain the Dancer's level 1 features, which are listed in the Dancer Features table.

As a Multiclass Character

  • Gain the following traits from the Core Dancer Traits table: Hit Point Die, proficiency with Simple weapons, and training with Light armor.
  • Gain the Dancer's level 1 features, which are listed in the Dancer Features table.
weapon_proficiencies: Martial weapons that have the Finesse or Light property

features.name: Dervish Fighting
features.description:
Your graceful movements and skill with nimble weapons grant you the following benefits.

Deadly D4s. Whenever you roll damage with a weapon that deals 1d4 or 1d6 damage or an Unarmed Strike, you can deal 2d4 damage instead.

Extra Finesse Weapons. While wielding a weapon that deals 1d4 or 1d6 damage, it has the Finesse property for you.

Dancing with Firearms. If using a Dancer in a setting with Firearms, Dervish Fighting has the following additional benefit.

Dervish Firearms. Whenever you roll damage with a weapon that deals 2d4 damage, you can deal 3d4 damage instead.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: Whenever you roll damage with a weapon that deals 1d4 or 1d6 damage or an Unarmed Strike, you can deal 2d4 damage instead.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Daggers and Hand Crossbows.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

features.name: Dance
features.description:
You can enter a flow state of Dance as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. Your Dance lasts for 1 minute, or until you have the Incapacitated condition, your Speed is 0, or you choose to stop dancing (no action required).

You can begin your Dance a number of times shown for your Dancer level in the Dances column of the Dancer features table. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Dance Die. Your dancing prowess is represented by a Dance Die, which is a d4. This die changes when you reach certain Dancer levels, as shown in the Dance Die column of the Dancer Features table.

Graceful Dodge. If a creature you can see hits you with an attack while your Dance is active, you can roll your Dance Die and add it to your Armor Class against this attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You can begin your Dance a number of times shown for your Dancer level in the Dances column of the Dancer features table.

menuOptions.name: Graceful Dodge
menuOptions.description: Roll your Dance Die and add it to your Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: If a creature you can see hits you with an attack while your Dance is active, you can roll your Dance Die and add it to your Armor Class against this attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

features.name: Dance Styles
features.description: When you begin your Dance, choose one of your Dance Styles. You know one Dance Style of your choice, and you learn an additional Dance Style of your choice when you reach Dancer level 13 (Freestyle). See custom abilities / Dance Style upgrades for options.

features.name: Nimble Start
features.description: Attacks against you during the first round of combat have Disadvantage.

features.name: Dancer Subclass
features.description: You gain a Dancer subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Dancer levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Dancer level or lower.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Dancer levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Three-Target Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack three times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack three times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail

features.name: Heroic Dance
features.description: When you begin your Dance, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration if you don't have it.

features.name: Four-Target Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack four times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack four times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

features.name: Graceful Retaliation
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself hits or misses you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make one attack against that creature, using a weapon with the Light or Finesse property or an Unarmed Strike. Your attack follows the triggering attack and its effects.

features.name: Freestyle
features.description: When you begin your Dance, you can choose two Dance Styles instead of one. You can change one style at a time as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Fierce Start
features.description: Whenever you deal damage to a creature with a weapon or Unarmed Strike on the first round of combat, you can add your Charisma modifier to the damage roll.

features.name: Five-Target Extra Attack
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack five times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack five times if all of your attacks are against different targets.

features.name: Invigorating Dance
features.description: When you begin your Dance, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Dancer level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

mechanics.sourcePhrase: you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Dancer level plus your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1)

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Grand Finale
features.description:
When you take the Attack action while your Dance is active, you can perform a Grand Finale. Until the end of your turn, any attack you make that hits becomes a Critical Hit, and you can make two additional attacks as a Bonus Action. At the end of your turn, your Dance ends.

You can't use this feature on the first round of combat, and once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending two uses of your Dance (no action required).

mechanics.sourcePhrase: once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending two uses of your Dance (no action required).

classes.card_blurb: A graceful, evasive skirmisher who turns footwork and flair into a deadly weapon in battle.

subclasses.name: Acrobat
subclasses.description: Acrobats vault, walk tightropes, and backflip over their foes to find new angles of approach. Such Dancers often perform with circuses or work for criminal organizations, and find endless applications for their skills in dungeon-diving. Moreover, an Acrobat can convert the momentum of their gymnastics into crushing force when a foe proves otherwise intractable.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: While your Dance is active, you gain Momentum when you leave an enemy's reach and each time you move 15 feet on your turn. When you hit a creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend your Momentum to deal extra damage equal to one roll of your Dance Die. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon. You can have only one Momentum at a time. At the end of your turn, you lose any unexpended Momentum.

features.name: Aerial Acrobat
features.description:
Your superior gymnastic skill grants you the following benefits.

Charismatic Acrobatics. You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill. Additionally, you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

Aerialist. You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

Climber. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics skill.
you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1)
You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Tumbling
features.description:
While your Agile Movement Dance Style is active, you gain the following benefits.

Fall Safely. The first time you fall each turn, reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your Dancer level.

Ignore Difficult Terrain. Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.

Speed Increase. Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: Speed Increase. Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Evasive Speed
features.description: When you move 30 feet or more during your turn, you can take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Deadly Momentum
features.description: You can have up to three Momentum at a time and you don't lose Momentum at the end of your turn while your Dance is active. When you hit a creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend up to three Momentum at once.

subclasses.name: Courtesan
subclasses.description: Dressed in finery, Courtesans are the very picture of cultured elegance. Rather than dancing like a jester for others' amusement, Courtesans leverage their unearthly grace to twist the affections of others. Most ingratiate themselves into high society, for a melodic tone and captivating glance is enough to enrapture most nobles.

features.name: Enthralling Movement [Dance Style]
features.description: When you choose this Dance Style and at the start of each of your turns while this Dance Style is active, choose a creature that can see you within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Honeyed Words
features.description:
Your eloquent speech grants you the following benefits.

Proficiencies. You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

Languages. You know two languages of your choice.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.
You know two languages of your choice.

features.name: Sociable Start
features.description: During the first round of combat, you can take the Influence action as a Bonus Action and have Advantage on ability checks you make using that action.

features.name: Beguiling Charm
features.description:
When you give a creature the Charmed condition, you can choose one of the following effects for the creature while it has the condition.

Bad Influence. The target subtracts your Dance Die from Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws it makes.

Friend of My Friends. The target subtracts your Dance Die from all its attack rolls.

features.name: Heartbreaker
features.description: Whenever a creature succeeds or fails its saving throw against your Enthralling Movement, you can deal Psychic damage to the target equal to two rolls of your Dance Die.

subclasses.name: Fencer
subclasses.description: Postured, graceful, and utterly deadly, Fencers favor one-handed parries and thrusts to whirling Daggers and Darts. Their repertoire of movements constitute a dance of footwork and bladework that can overcome most foes with a few precise movements and pinpoint strikes.

features.name: Dueling Stance [Dance Style]
features.description: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you can add one roll of your Dance Die to damage rolls with that weapon.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: you can add one roll of your Dance Die to damage rolls with that weapon

features.name: Panache
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill. Additionally, you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill.
you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum bonus of +1)

features.name: Fencing Maneuvers
features.description:
While your Dance is active, you can perform the following maneuvers.

Disarm. As a Bonus Action, you can attempt to disarm a creature you can see within 5 feet of you. The target makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, it drops one item of your choice that it's holding. The object lands in a space you choose within 10 feet of the target.

En Garde. As a Bonus Action, you can goad an enemy that can see or hear you into attacking you. Until the start of your next turn, the enemy has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you while it is within 5 feet of you. This effect ends early if your Dance ends.

Lunge. As a Bonus Action, you can increase your reach by 5 feet with weapons that lack the Two-Handed or Versatile properties until the start of your next turn. This effect ends early if your Dance ends.

features.name: Parry and Riposte
features.description:
When you use your Graceful Dodge, you can take a Reaction to add another roll of your Dance Die to your Armor Class for this attack.

Starting at Dancer level 11, if you use this feature and the triggering attack misses you, you can use your Graceful Retaliation as a part of the same Reaction.

You can take this Reaction a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

mechanics.sourcePhrase: You can take this Reaction a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once). You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Superior Flourish
features.description: When you score a Critical Hit or reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points on your turn, you regain up to 15 feet of expended movement and can make one additional attack on your turn. You can make up to three such additional attacks on a single turn.

class_resources.name: Dances
class_resources.description: The number of times a Dancer can begin their Dance flow state. Regains one use on a Short Rest and all uses on a Long Rest.

class_resources.name: Dance Die
class_resources.description: A scaling die that many Dancer features reference (Graceful Dodge, Dance Styles, subclass features). Not a spendable pool; it grows in size as the Dancer levels up.

class_resources.name: Momentum
class_resources.description: Acrobat-only tracker. Gained by leaving an enemy's reach or moving 15 feet on your turn while dancing; expended for bonus damage equal to a roll of your Dance Die. Cap is 1, rising to 3 at 14th level (Deadly Momentum); unexpended Momentum is normally lost at the end of your turn.

creatures.name: Skeleton Spirit
creatures.hp: 1 (the spirit has no Hit Point Dice)
creatures.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak
creatures.description: A spectral skeleton summoned by a Danseur Macabre's Danse Macabre Dance Style. Its attack bonus and DCs scale off the summoner, and its PB equals the summoner's Proficiency Bonus.

actions.name: Spectral Bolt
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 1d4 Necrotic damage.
